aqi.sensitive: Aan Caafimaad ahayn Kooxaha Xasaasiga ah
advice.good: Tayada hawo waa wanaagsan. Ku raaxayso hawlaha dibadda!
advice.moderate: Tayada dhexdhexaad ah. Dadka xasaasiga ah waa inay xaddidaan waqtiga.
advice.sensitive: Aan caafimaad ahayn kooxaha xasaasiga ah. Xidho maaskaro haddii loo baahdo.
advice.unhealthy: Tayada hawo way hoos u dhacday. Yaree hawlaha dibadda.
insight.good: Nadiifi xaaladaha hawada sababtoo ah kala firdhinta dabaysha. Badbaadada dhammaan hawlaha.
insight.moderate: Dhisidda qayb yar. Shuruudaha waa la aqbali karaa dadka intooda badan.
insight.sensitive: Walxaha kor u kacay ee laga yaabo inay ka yimaadaan qiiqa deegaanka. Kooxaha xasaasiga ah waa inay taxadaraan.
insight.unhealthy: Degganaanshiyo qayb sare leh oo la arkay. Waxay soo jeedinaysaa ilaha gubashada deegaanka.
insight.hazardous: Tayada hawada khatarta ah. Gudaha joog oo isticmaal sifaynta hawada haddii ay suurtagal tahay.
about.title: Ku saabsan Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI waxay qiimeysaa PM2.5 maalin kasta 54-ka dal ee Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Intooda badan magaalooyinka Afrika ma hayaan qalabka kormeernta hawo. Waxaan buuxinaa meesha maran.
about.how.intro: Isticmaalka xogta satellite iyo barashada mishinka.
about.how.step1.title: Satellites Sida Sensors
about.how.step1.desc: Isticmaalka xogta ESA Sentinel-5P iyo NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Hagaajinta Dhulka
about.how.step2.desc: Nashqad lagu tababaray 398 xarun oo kormeern ah 29 dal.
about.how.step3.title: Saadaalinta Qaaradda
about.how.step3.desc: Nashqada XGBoost waxay saadaalinaysaa PM2.5 meel kasta oo Afrika ah.
about.limit.intro: Xadidaadyo muhiim ah oo la og yahay.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Satellites ma arki karaan iyagoo dhex socda daruura waaweyn.
about.limit.gap_desc: Marinta satellite maalin kasta waxay dhaafi kartaa kor u kaca wasakhda gaaban.
about.limit.legal_desc: Qiyaasaha ma aha cabbirrada la aqbali karo.
about.who.citizens_desc: Hubi tayada hawo ka hor hawlaha dibadda.

report.subtitle: Ku tabaruc xogta bulshada.
report.location_mock: Isticmaalka goobta laga soo qaatay bartanka khariidada
report.placeholder_obs: tusaale: Ur qiiq, ceeryaamo la arki karo...
report.clue.good: Hawo ayaa cusub. Ma jirto ceeryaamo la arki karo.
report.clue.moderate: Hawo waa la aqbali karaa. Ceeryaamo fudud.
report.clue.unhealthy: Qiiq/smog la arki karo. Xanaaq fudud.
